## Canon

- [AEGIS-GUIDE-017 — Platform Capabilities](./03-platform-capabilities.md): AEGIS is designed around one top-level business capability: **governed agentic delivery**.
- [AEGIS-GUIDE-018 — Architecture and Integrations](./04-architecture-and-integrations.md): AEGIS is designed as a provider-neutral governance layer between human or agent intent and the tools that execute or record work.
- [AEGIS-GUIDE-019 — Security, Governance, and Assurance](./05-security-governance-and-assurance.md): AEGIS is designed to add layered governance to human and AI-assisted work. It does not claim that a CLI, signature, ticket, gate, or telemetry stream is sufficient on its own.
